# The song library with the demo's made-up songs (12 per page): the grid, holding Down to the end of a long list,
# the shelf scrolled to its end, and the carousel.
# Run it: gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=<branch> -f script=.github/checks/library.txt

cmd weather clear
cmd time set noon
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
set libraryView GRID
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
shot library-grid

# Down, one row at a time, past the first page: each new page should load and the selection carry on
key down
sleep 0.5
key down
sleep 0.5
key down
sleep 0.5
key down
sleep 1.5
shot library-grid-down4
key down
sleep 0.5
key down
sleep 0.5
key down
sleep 0.5
key down
sleep 0.5
key down
sleep 0.5
key down
sleep 1.5
shot library-grid-down10
key end
sleep 2
shot library-grid-end

# The shelf, scrolled to its end: "Loading…" (while a page comes) must show whole after the last column
close
set libraryView SHELF
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
shot library-shelf
key end
sleep 0.3
shot library-shelf-end-a
sleep 2
shot library-shelf-end-b

# The carousel
close
set libraryView CAROUSEL
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
shot library-carousel
key right
sleep 0.5
key right
sleep 1
shot library-carousel-right2
close
set libraryView GRID
